eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Siskiyou, CA; at 7:36 PM on AUG 16, 2023 Effective until 3:36 AM AUG 17, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
An evacuation order is being issued for Zone 2001-B which is the portion of Zone 2001 that is North of Scott River Rd. Anyone in this area is ordered to leave immediately due to a wildfire in the area 

An evacuation shelter is open at the Karuk Wellness Center at 1403 Kahtishraam, Yreka

Visit community.zonehaven.com for the latest evacuation zone statuses
